adv.headerTitle: Advanced Hyperparameters (Optional Strategy Tuning · Verified Across 206 Blind Runs & 9 Shots)
adv.headerSub: All off by default = 100% Nuke CopyCat native strategy · Exported models remain 100% Nuke Inference compatible
adv.introHtml: Each of the 5 strategy tunings below was verified across 9 production VFX shot types and 206 blind holdout + sequence-flicker benchmarks (speculative tweaks falsified by raw data were removed). With all toggles off, training reproduces Nuke CopyCat 100% natively; enabling any option preserves network inference topology and logs comparable 1/1 MSE. Click any item to inspect how Nuke CopyCat works, exact empirical boundaries, and the LaTeX formulation.

cg.title: All-Phase Unbiased Crop Origin Sampling (Eliminates Full-Frame Stride Phase Mismatch)
cg.badge: Zero overhead · +4.93 dB blind Unseen leap on clean marker cleanup (54.09→59.02 dB)
cg.nukeHtml: CopyCat anchors crop origins to the bottom edge (Nuke Y-up origin) on a rigid 4-pixel grid: y₀ = (H - C) - 4·k_y. Because the encoder uses two stride=2 downsampling stages (net stride 4), whenever plate height or width is not a multiple of 4 (e.g. scope formats like 2048×858 or 855 rows where (H - C) mod 4 ≠ 0), every training crop lands on a single modulo-4 phase while full-frame inference starts at top-left y = 0 — evaluating every pixel on an unseen strided-convolution phase and imposing a 4–5.6 dB full-frame PSNR ceiling!
cg.oursTitle: ② What Our Tuning Does (#1 Single-Knob Blind Gain)
cg.oursHtml: Unlocks full-resolution crop stride from 4 px to 1 px (uniform all-phase sampling), uniformly covering all 16 {0,1,2,3}×{0,1,2,3} downsampling phases so shared kernels learn true sub-stride shift equivariance. With zero extra compute cost, switching this single knob lifts blind SmartVector marker cleanup from 54.09 dB to 59.02 dB (+4.93 dB)! (Note: on grainy live-action plates, always pair 1px with Item 02 Composite Robust Loss rather than pure MSE.)
cg.mathCaption: ▸ Bottom-anchored 4px grid vs. 1px uniform phase coverage (eliminates train/inference phase mismatch):
cg.opt1Desc: Covers all 16 stride phases; eliminates non-mod-4 full-frame phase shift and pan/zoom micro-flicker
cg.opt2Desc: Covers even/odd half-stride phases, balancing first-level stride=2 alignment with shift robustness

lf.title: Composite Perceptual Loss: Charbonnier + L1 Spatial Gradient + ACEScg HDR Damping
lf.badge: +2.95 dB Keying (64.40 dB) · 10.2× cleaner Roto blacks · 4.1× cleaner untouched plate
lf.nukeHtml: CopyCat minimizes raw linear-space squared error MSE = mean((ŷ - y)²) in ACEScg. Benchmarks reveal two weaknesses: ① Unmodified-background color drift & soft edges: once residuals drop to 10⁻³, L2 gradients vanish, leaving ~0.0005 lift on untouched plates, gray haze in black Roto mattes, and soft fine edges; ② HDR specular gradient dominance: tiny halo errors on 12+ stop metal/headlight highlights produce squared gradients hundreds of times larger than shadow skin tones, starving midtones and shadows.
lf.oursTitle: ② What Our Tuning Does (Task-Matched Loss Physics)
lf.oursHtml: Preserves 100% pure linear ACEScg model inputs and outputs (plugs straight into Nuke Inference with zero extra nodes) while blending three backprop terms: ① Charbonnier smooth L1: stops squared L2 from overfitting film grain and sustains restoring force on tiny residuals, cutting untouched plate drift by 4.1×–6.2× and 1ch Roto black haze by 10.2×; ② L1 spatial gradient λ_grad: pushing Grad to 0.15 hits an all-run record 64.40 dB on RGBA Keying; ③ Weber-Fechner HDR damping α: damps RGB radiance channels only (4th-channel RGBA Alpha stays strictly 1.0 linear; 1ch Roto locks α = 0).
lf.mathCaption: ▸ ACEScg luminance-damped residual, Charbonnier smooth L1, and damped spatial gradient composite loss:
lf.hdrPreviewHtml: Live HDR squared-weight response (α={alpha}): Shadows Lum=0.1 retain {shadowPct}% · Mid-white Lum=1.0 retains {midPct}% · 12-stop Specular Lum=12.0 damped to {highPct}%

st.title: Multi-Resolution Stage Ratios & Stage-Transition LR Warmup
st.badge: Use 15/25/60 for Wide Bokeh (beats 1M in 500k) · Keep Off (33/33/34) elsewhere
st.disabledBanner: Multi-Resolution is set to Off above (training runs as a single 1/1 full-resolution stage with no 1/4 → 1/2 → 1/1 scale transitions), so this option is automatically disabled. Items 01 / 02 / 04 / 05 remain fully active in single-scale mode.
st.switchTip: Toggle custom stage split & transition warmup
st.nukeHtml: With Multi-Resolution enabled, CopyCat splits total steps T into three equal thirds ⌈T/3⌉ : ⌈T/3⌉ : rem across Bicubic (align_corners=True) scales 1/4 → 1/2 → 1/1 (crops 64 → 128 → 256). Empirically, the coarse 1/4 stage plateaus within 15% of steps while pore-level 1/1 full resolution gets only the final third, and abrupt scale jumps without LR warmup shock Adam's second moment v_t.
st.oursTitle: ② What Our Tuning Does (Strict Scenario Boundary)
st.oursHtml: Reallocates stage budgets (default 15% : 25% : 60%) with a K_warm-step linear LR ramp at scale jumps. Full blind benchmarks established a crisp rule: ① On wide optical Bokeh & motion-blur recovery, 1/4 and 1/2 alter the blur disc and stall — enabling 15/25/60 gains +0.77 dB and beats 1M runs in 500k steps! ② On Keying (15/25/60 lost -0.69 dB), Cleanup (45/40/15 lost -0.09 to -0.77 dB), Degrain, and Roto, keeping Nuke's equal 33/33/34 split (toggle Off) generalizes best!
st.mathCaption: ▸ Nuke native equal-third stage boundaries vs. custom stage ratios and transition LR warmup:
st.barSummary: Stage step allocation (Total {T} Steps; Nuke Native: {n1} / {n2} / {n3})

el.title: Stage-Reset Adaptive EMA Shadow Weights Export
el.badge: +2.11 dB over unreset EMA at stage jumps · Zero steady-state lag at β=0.9995
el.nukeHtml: CopyCat uses a gentle polynomial LR schedule η(k) = η₀·(1 - (k-1)/T)^0.3 (which preserves 72% LR entering the final 1/1 stage — replacing it with global Cosine actually underfits full resolution), yet exports raw single-step weights θ_k at checkpoints, leaving mid-training exports vulnerable to mini-batch stochastic jitter.
el.oursTitle: ② What Our Tuning Does (Stage-Reset + ~2k-Step Window)
el.oursHtml: Keeps Nuke's exact poly(0.3) LR schedule and main optimizer trajectory 100% untouched while maintaining Stage-Reset warmup-corrected EMA shadow weights θ̃_k inside the CUDA Graph: resets the EMA step counter at each 1/4 → 1/2 → 1/1 resolution jump to flush blurry coarse weights (+2.11 dB over unreset 0.9999 right after entering 1/1 on Bokeh), while using β = 0.9995 (~2,000-step window) to avoid 0.9999's steady-state lag (+0.42 dB on Keying).
el.mathCaption: ▸ Adaptive warmup EMA shadow recurrence and effective low-pass step window:
el.previewHtml: Active smoothing (β={decay}): Effective window ≈ {effSteps} Steps · Half-life ≈ {halfLife} Steps (optimizer LR stays 100% Nuke Poly p=0.3)

aug.title: Semantic-Preserving Optical Augmentation (Paired H-Flip + Linear Exposure Jitter)
aug.badge: HFlip 0.5 cuts playback flicker by -25.9% · Keep Exposure Jitter at 0 EV
aug.statusOff: Nuke Native: No flip or exposure jitter
aug.nukeHtml: CopyCat applies zero geometric flips or photometric gain jitter (crop gain fixed at 1.0, offset 0). Avoiding flips preserves directional features on asymmetric single-shot paintouts, but training multi-shot denoise/keying models from 3–5 keyframes or flickering practical lights can overfit to exact plate exposure.
aug.oursTitle: ② What Our Tuning Does (HFlip Wins · Keep EV = 0)
aug.oursHtml: Provides two in-place GPU optical augmentations with clear single-variable audit verdicts: ① Synchronized Horizontal Flip (50% HFlip): breaks XY coordinate and pore memorization on sparse keyframes, cutting 113-frame playback flicker by -25.9% and improving untouched BG cleanliness by 4.1× on 5-frame facial cleanup (set 0% on text, logos, or asymmetric motion); ② Linear exposure jitter (±EV): controlled ablations showed EV > 0 degraded untouched plate color lock by +18% (locked 0 on 1ch Roto) — keep at 0.00 EV by default.
aug.mathCaption: ▸ Synchronized horizontal flip and channel-aware linear radiance exposure gain:
aug.flipOpt0: 0% (No flip · For text, logos, strong one-sided lighting, or asymmetric motion)
aug.flipOpt50: 50% (Random mirror · Top anti-flicker choice for facial & rig cleanup)

help.bannerDesc: Distilled from zero-prior verification across a 21-GPU heterogeneous cluster (RTX 5090 / 5090 D / 4090 / A100) training {epochsM}M raw epochs ({shadowM}M shadow-weight steps · {h16}h 16-GPU equivalent across 9 VFX shot types and 206 blind runs). help.sec2Title: Which Improvements Actually Work — and Which Fail? (Blind Test Summary)
help.sec2EvalRule: Evaluation Rule: Large models easily memorize training film grain up to 70+ dB. Every verdict below is judged strictly on held-out blind frames (Unseen PSNR ↑) and 100-frame continuous playback chatter (HFI ↓).
help.grpEffTitle: ✅ Proven Effective Improvements (6 Items · Consistent Blind Gains)
help.eff1Title: Lossless Engine Acceleration (CUDA Graph + VRAM Resident + Fused Adam + NHWC)
help.eff1Desc: Eliminates per-step dispatch overhead (10×+ faster in 1/4 stage) while matching CopyCat loss stage-for-stage across 200k epochs. Keep enabled at all times.
help.eff2Title: 01 · 1px All-Offset Crop Grid (Fixes Nuke's 4px Stride Blind Spots)
help.eff2Desc: Nuke steps crop origins by 4px, skipping 15/16 of pixel phases. Switching to 1px jumped clean SmartVector cleanup from 54.09 to 59.02 dB on Small (pair with Composite Loss on grainy plates).
help.eff3Title: 02 · Composite Robust & Edge-Gradient Loss (Replaces Pure MSE)
help.eff3Desc: Charbonnier prevents squared overfitting to film grain and keeps untouched plates 4.1–6.2× cleaner; High Edge Grad on 4ch Keying (Grad=0.15, HDR=0.35 on RGB, pure linear Alpha) hits 64.40 dB; locking HDR=0 on 1ch Roto cuts black haze 10.2×.
help.eff4Title: 03 · Fine-Heavy Stage Split (15% / 25% / 60%) for Wide Bokeh & Optical Blur
help.eff4Desc: Wide optical bokeh stalls in 1/4 and 1/2 because downsampling alters the blur disc; allocating 60% of steps to 1/1 hits 41.15 dB at 500k on Medium, beating 1M equal stages (keep standard 33/33/34 for Keying, Cleanup, Degrain, and Roto).
help.eff5Desc: Flushes blurry coarse-stage history at each 1/4 → 1/2 → 1/1 jump while using β=0.9995 (~2k-step window) for instant transition recovery and zero steady-state lag on Keying.
help.eff6Desc: Pure Horizontal Flip 0.5 (with Exposure 0 EV) breaks XY coordinate and pore memorization on 5-frame facial cleanup, winning lowest playback flicker (-25.9%) and 4.1× cleaner untouched background at 30.79 dB (disable on text or logos).
help.grpCondTitle: ⚠️ Scenario-Dependent Double-Edged Knobs (4 Items · Blindly Increasing Hurts!)
help.cond1Title: Scaling Up to Large Model (Helps Defocus/Blur Only; Hurts Most Other Shots)
help.cond1Desc: Large helps ONLY wide optical kernels — Bokeh (+4.38 dB) and Motion Blur (+2.48 dB). On Keying (-2.71 dB), Dance Roto (-3.97 dB), Parkour Roto (-1.26 dB), and Degrain (-0.79 dB), Large memorizes training frames, drops blind accuracy, and runs 4–5× slower. Default to Small.
help.cond2Desc: On 960×540 HD plates, Crop 512 leaves <28px vertical room, collapsing random crop diversity at 4× cost and losing -2.85 dB on Keying and -2.55 dB on Bokeh. Rule: keep Crop ≤ 50–60% of the shorter side (256 default; 384 on 2K+ cleanup).
help.cond3Badge: Grainy Shots Dip in 1/1 · Missing Poses Stay Flat
help.cond3Desc: Grainy live-action plates start memorizing noise once inside 1/1 full-res, so running 2× longer increases flicker; on pose-starved Roto, Large @2M (8.3h) stays at 12.22 dB whereas painting 2 extreme keyframes on Small (76m) jumps to 16.30 dB (+4.07 dB).
help.cond4Title: Keyframe Count & Placement (Center Hero Frame Beats Boundary Pair)
help.cond4Desc: On facial cleanup, painting 1 center hero frame (30.98 dB, zero cross-frame paint inconsistency, -14.8% flicker) beat painting 2 boundary-only frames (29.71 dB). Paint the middle hero frame first for cleanup; paint widest limb extremes (4–6f) for articulated Roto.
help.grpBadTitle: ❌ Ineffective or Negative Ideas (5 Items · Falsified in Blind Tests)
help.bad1Title: Residual Smart Crop Focusing on Edit Regions (Removed from UI)
help.bad1Desc: Over-sampling the 1% edited patch caused catastrophic forgetting of the 99% untouched background, introducing severe full-frame color shifts.
help.bad2Title: Enabling Naked 1px Crop Grid with Pure MSE on Grainy Plates
help.bad2Desc: Pure MSE forces the network to memorize exact film-grain coordinates across every pixel offset; grainy plates must pair 1px with Composite Robust Loss.
help.bad3Title: Alternative LR Decay Shapes (Poly 0.7 / TailCosine / Global Cosine) & Stage Warmup
help.bad3Desc: Global Cosine starves 1/1 fine detail; Poly 0.7, TailCosine, and 200-step stage warmup stay within 0.07 dB of default Poly 0.3 — keep the default schedule.
help.bad4Title: Coarse Gradient Detach, 45/40/15 Stage Split & Exposure Jitter (EV > 0)
help.bad4Desc: Falsified in controlled blind tests: (1) Coarse gradient detach breaks multi-scale fusion (-0.69 dB, removed); (2) 45/40/15 starves 1/1 skin detail (-0.09 to -0.77 dB); (3) Exposure jitter EV>0 degrades untouched plate color lock (+18% drift, -2.53 dB on Roto) — keep EV at 0.
help.bad5Title: Unreset Cross-Stage 0.9999 EMA & Holding Out Val Frames When Total Keyframes ≤ 6
help.bad5Desc: Unreset 0.9999 EMA suffers both -2.11 dB jump drag and 10k-step steady lag (replaced by Stage-Reset EMA 0.9995); sacrificing 1 of ≤6 keyframes for internal validation costs ~20% coverage (-0.48 to -0.75 dB at K=5) — train on all frames when ≤6f and hold out a val frame when ≥7f.

help.sec6Badge: Section 6 · Hardware Throughput & GPU Speed DB
help.benchTitle: Training Throughput: WildCat vs. Nuke 17.0v2 CopyCat (Same GPU & Settings)
help.benchSetup: Nuke 17.0v2 CopyCat vs. WildCat (default lossless acceleration) on the exact same workstation and GPU; 40 frames of 772×855 half-float EXR, Multi-Resolution On, Mixed Precision = Adaptive. Columns show steady-state steps/s per stage:
help.benchNote1: Coarse stages (1/4, 1/2) accelerate most by capturing the entire training step into a single CUDA Graph.
help.benchNote2: Full-resolution (1/1) approaches GPU compute limits, yielding a 2.1–5.5× end-to-end speedup.
help.benchNote3: VRAM & Dual-GPU Policy: Datasets ≤60% of free VRAM stay GPU-resident (larger sets use pinned RAM prefetch with 0–4% overhead); dual-GPU systems offload previews and validation to the secondary GPU.
help.benchNote4: Parity Check: Stage-by-stage loss across 200k epochs matches CopyCat (final 10k-step mean loss: 0.000046 vs. 0.000045).
help.gpuSpeedDbTitle: Shipped Empirical GPU Speed Database (data/gpu_benchmarks.db · Accurate ETA Engine)
help.gpuSpeedDbDesc: Real 3-stage throughput extracted from 206 training runs across 4 GPU architectures (with augmentation overhead factor calibrated; independent backtest median error is just 4.1%):
help.gpuSpeedUntestedNote: Untested GPU Policy: Tested GPUs use empirical bucket lookup + Roofline interpolation; untested GPUs are estimated from existing data via bandwidth/clock scaling and dynamically self-calibrated once live steps/s is observed.

admin.gpuPoolDesc: Dynamically lists all detected physical GPUs. The Primary GPU takes Auto Queue training jobs first; the Secondary GPU runs parallel overflow jobs when Primary is full and serves first as the zero-contention live preview/validation card (cuda:1) when idle. Disabled GPUs never receive new tasks or preview workloads.

lab.tableSectionTitle: Quantitative Error & Unsupervised Temporal Stability Table
lab.tipSupPsnr: Supervised keyframe Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (dB) measured in OCIO display sRGB [0,1]; higher means cleaner perceptual fidelity.
lab.tipSupEdge: Spatial 1st-order gradient L1 error vs. Ground Truth (×1000); lower means sharper hair, edges, and fine detail.
lab.tipSupBg: Mean pixel drift (×1000) over untouched plate regions where Source == Target; lower means zero unwanted color cast.
lab.tipSupP99: 99th-percentile pixel L1 error (×1000), capturing worst-case local ringing or artifacts.
lab.tipSeqDelta: Unsupervised 1st-order edit-layer jitter across the full sequence: mean|(ŷ_t − x_t) − (ŷ_{t-1} − x_{t-1})| ×1000; lower means smoother frame-to-frame edits.
lab.tipSeqHfi: Unsupervised 2nd-order temporal acceleration chatter: mean|δ_t − 2δ_{t-1} + δ_{t-2}| ×1000. Constant-velocity motion cancels to 0, isolating high-frequency flicker.
lab.tipSeqStatic: Output boiling noise (×1000) on locked-off static background pixels (|x_t − x_{t-1}| < 0.005); ideal is 0.

lab.comboSub: Starting from our empirically verified preset for your task type, relaxes surrounding parameter bounds (model capacity, crop context, stage schedule, loss weights, and augmentation symmetry) into a complementary multi-run suite — ideal for overnight runs that can outperform any single fixed recipe.
lab.comboSeqOptionalHint: No eval sequence attached (tracks paired ROI fidelity; attach sequence for flicker scoring)
lab.comboAutoExtendLabel: Auto-extend if still improving at cap
lab.comboStopAfterOptHint: Designed for multi-run exploration: once in the 1/1 full-resolution stage, if the specified number of additional epochs pass after the best checkpoint without meaningful improvement, training stops cleanly to free the GPU for the next candidate.
lab.comboReason_cg_1: Empirical anti-flicker anchor: Small + equal 33/33/34 + 1px + robust loss + pure HFlip 0.5 (0 EV) for -25.9% flicker & 4.1× cleaner BG
lab.comboReason_cg_2: Top 5-frame converged PSNR recipe: Medium 220k + tight crop + no aug to maximize local skin/texture fidelity (30.83 dB)
lab.comboReason_cg_3: Medium capacity + wide crop (auto 384 on ≥720p) + HFlip: ideal for 2K/4K broad scars, wire rigs, and garment structure
lab.comboReason_cg_4: No horizontal flip (NoFlip) + Small 400k: preserves directional side-lighting, signage, logos, or asymmetric grain
lab.comboReason_cg_5: Stronger edge gradient (Charb 0.30 + 0.12∇) + HFlip: sharpens specular props, collars, and crisp facial features
lab.comboReason_cg_6: Large capacity + wide crop + HFlip ceiling probe: tests wide structural occlusions when ≥7 keyframes are available
lab.comboReason_cg_7: Pure 1px all-phase grid + linear MSE: checks whether clean high-SNR synthetic plates prefer un-damped MSE
lab.comboReason_kd_1: 64.40 dB overall champion anchor: Small color lock + equal 33/33/34 + 0.15∇ edge + HDR 0.35 (damps RGB only; pure linear Alpha)
lab.comboReason_kd_2: Gentle edge weight (Charb 0.25 + 0.05∇ + HDR 0.50): smooths heavy motion-blurred hair, smoke, and soft semi-transparent falloff
lab.comboReason_kd_3: Extended 750k fine convergence + 0.15∇: resolves sub-pixel wispy hair strands and intricate edge despill
lab.comboReason_kd_4: Steps capacity up to Medium (0.10∇ + HDR 0.35): handles unevenly lit backing screens, sheer fabric, and glass
lab.comboReason_kd_5: Un-damped linear RGB+Alpha loss (HDR 0.0 + 0.15∇): tailored for pre-despilled or controlled SDR studio greenscreens
lab.comboReason_kd_6: Wide crop context (auto 384 on ≥720p) + 0.12∇: captures broad floor/garment bounce spill across high-res plates
lab.comboReason_kd_7: Adds symmetric HFlip 0.5 (0 EV) + 0.15∇: prevents actor XY memorization when ≤4 painted keyframes are provided
lab.comboReason_bf_1: +9.72 dB Bokeh champion anchor: Large receptive field + 15/25/60 full-res focus + HDR 0.50 highlight control + 0.10∇
lab.comboReason_bf_2: Large + equal 33/33/34 stages (600k): proven multi-frame motion-blur recovery champion route (47.13 dB)
lab.comboReason_bf_3: Large + wide crop (auto 384 on ≥720p) + 15/25/60: encloses oversized 2K/4K optical bokeh discs inside each patch
lab.comboReason_bf_4: Medium capacity + 15/25/60 (500k): hits 41.15 dB in half the runtime while preventing sparse-keyframe overfitting
lab.comboReason_bf_5: High spatial gradient recovery (Charb 0.30 + 0.18∇) + 15/25/60: maximizes crispness on signage, weave, and hard optical edges
lab.comboReason_bf_6: Linear un-damped recovery (HDR 0.0 + 0.10∇): ideal for standard SDR motion-trail recovery without specular blowouts
lab.comboReason_bf_7: Compact Small shift-invariant probe + HFlip: tests mild soft-focus or ultra-sparse 2–3 keyframe shots (46.47 dB on 2f)
lab.comboReason_dg_1: 41.78 dB Degrain empirical anchor: Small spectral prior + 1px + C0.25/G0.05/H0.50 (paired with ~70% optimal peak lock)
lab.comboReason_dg_2: Extended 600k clean-plate polish (HDR 0.35): thoroughly erases tracking markers and tiny blemishes on clean plates
lab.comboReason_dg_3: Higher edge preservation (0.15∇ + HDR 0.50): retains crisp architectural lines, props, and fine texture during degrain
lab.comboReason_dg_4: Paired HFlip 0.5 (0 EV) regularization: breaks static XY chroma blotches and suppresses shadow breathing across long shots
lab.comboReason_dg_5: Medium capacity (400k): designed for combined sensor degrain + blemish/rig paintout in a single pass
lab.comboReason_dg_6: Single-knob 1px all-phase grid + pure linear MSE: proven +4.93 dB (59.02 dB) SmartVector clean-plate marker winner
lab.comboReason_dg_7: Wide crop context (auto 384 on ≥720p) + Small: suppresses broad low-frequency shadow chroma blotches on 2K/4K plates
lab.comboReason_rm_1: Parkour/Dance Roto champion anchor: Small anti-memorization + 600k + 1px + C0.25/G0.05/HDR 0.0 (10.2× cleaner matte blacks)
lab.comboReason_rm_2: Extended 900k matte refinement: tightens flowing garment folds and fast motion-blurred semi-transparent Alpha edges
lab.comboReason_rm_3: Crisp Alpha contour gradient (Charb 0.30 + 0.12∇ + HDR 0.0): sharpens articulated limb cutouts and finger gaps
lab.comboReason_rm_4: Pure 1px all-phase grid + linear L2 Alpha: checks whether broad motion-blurred matte falloff prefers pure L2 smoothness
lab.comboReason_rm_5: Symmetric HFlip 0.5 (0 EV): doubles left-right limb pose coverage for front-facing dance and action turns
lab.comboReason_rm_6: Wide crop (auto 384 on ≥720p) + Small: encloses full sleeve/cape silhouette continuity to eliminate interior matte holes
lab.comboReason_rm_7: Medium capacity + wide crop: probes complex overlapping silhouettes when ≥8 painted keyframes are available
lab.comboReason_nuke: 100% Nuke CopyCat native control run (matched primary model size + 4px grid + pure MSE + all advanced toggles off)
